title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis 2027 and commitment proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer. The alloy surcharge index has fallen: idx:AS-14404@2026-06 stood at 3182.6744 and idx:AS-14404@2026-09 at 3007.8019, a change of -5.49 %. Your second driver also fell: idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05 was 131.9 and idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08 was 129.1, a change of -2.12 %. Our forecast fc:370010@2026-09 records a change of 1.9 % for this part.

We offer a longer commitment of 23,700 kg per year over 24 or 36 months, with no index clause. The attached term sheets carry the details. Since this exceeds your 2 % threshold, could you please put it to your pricing committee? Is there a cheaper variant, such as a different bar length or finish?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis 2027 and commitment proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we have verified the recent index developments you cited, allowing us to reduce our price accordingly. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

Our offer is a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Please note that for a 24-month commitment, we must include the AS-14404 index clause, as we cannot offer a fixed price over this duration. 

Alternatively, with a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Regarding your technical question, our standard bar lengths and finishes already represent the most cost-effective variants available. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – committee review of a fixed price over 24 or 36 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for the revised offer. Your twelve-month figures do not change the fact that both of your main drivers fell over the most recent quarter, as you verified.

Your delivery performance also weighs in our sourcing decision: sc:70740@2026Q3 records an on-time delivery rate of 81.0 %.

We offer a firm commitment of 23,700 kg per year over 24 or 36 months, as set out in the attached term sheets. This is the volume account your sales director said Blankstahl wants to focus on.

As this exceeds your 2 % threshold, could you please put it to your pricing committee? Your owner offered to walk us through your calculation of material and hourly rates. We would welcome that.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – committee review of a fixed price over 24 or 36 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We value our business relationship and appreciate your trust in our service and broad product range.

We have verified the delivery performance data you cited. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our terms stand at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. As we cannot offer a fixed price over a 24-month period, we must include the AS-14404 index clause. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 7 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.
